utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are coming by this afternoon to drop off tools and check what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, this afternoon? Are you sure that’s still the plan?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s what I heard, yeah—unless something changed last minute. I can swing by and see if there’s an updated notice.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and remind folks to pitch in. If you want, I can also help organize who needs what.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — that’d be really helpful. I might’ve missed a few details, so having you organize it would be great.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep people posted and help sort out who needs what for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Around 3 should be fine — I’ll be home then.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll stop by around 3.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need a few more hands, some duct tape, and a couple of screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring duct tape and a screwdriver. Want me to ask a couple neighbors to help too?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — I can help coordinate around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — that really helps. I’ll line up the repair drive around the school schedule and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — just send me the times, and I’ll work around them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m in — just tell me the plan and what time you need me there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks, Eli — I’ll put the plan together and let you know the time as soon as I’ve got it straight.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll wait for your update and keep my schedule open.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, just a heads-up — I’m spreading the word about the repair drive, and you’re invited. If you can swing by, it should be a nice chance to help out and catch up with folks.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — I’d like to help, but I’ll need the time and place first so I can make sure I can get there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s this Saturday at 10 a.m. over at the community center. Hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive happening, but I’m still getting the details second-hand. What do you know about it?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — we’re putting together a neighborhood repair drive to help folks with small fixes and maintenance. I’m still collecting the final details, but I can let you know as soon as the time and place are set.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’d appreciate that. Just keep me posted when you know the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs repairing and when the drive is happening? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — we’re gathering any broken household items and small furniture that folks want fixed, and the repair drive is this Saturday afternoon at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — broken household items and small furniture, this Saturday afternoon at the community hall. I’ll keep that straight before I help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep it simple right now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli — simple works for me. I’ll join in late and just handle a small part of the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That means a lot, Dane. I’ll keep it small and let you know where I need you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring a few tools over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus — what time should I expect you?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can be there around 3 this afternoon with the tool bag.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of the repair drive spots—where should I note the first stop?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Put the first stop at my place—I'll be ready when you swing by.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll mark your place as the first stop.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring over a few tools for the repair drive if that would help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be really helpful, Gus. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help — I’ll bring them by before the repair drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to know the timing and where to drop things off so I can plan it properly.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, fair question — can you confirm the pickup timing and the drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help if we have the timing and drop-off spot nailed down first. Once I know that, I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help bridge folks together for the repair drive—who should I reach out to first?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Let’s start with the folks who’ve already asked for help, then the hardware store and the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll reach out to the folks who asked for help first, then check in with the hardware store and community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a list of what we still need for the repair drive, so I can check supplies and see what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’m running a bit late, but I can help check what’s missing once you’ve got the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries, Dane — I’ll sort the list and let you know what we’re short on. Then we can fill in the gaps together.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely—people are pitching in with tools, parts, and a lot of goodwill. If you want, I can keep an eye out for any updates and pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess — that would be really helpful. I’m trying to keep track of everything around school pickups, so any updates you hear would be great.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if I hear anything new about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I’m in — just send me the details and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I’ll send over the repair drive details now, and if anything looks off, just flag it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out and let you know if I spot anything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what kind of help does the repair drive need?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly hands for sorting donations and a few folks with tools for basic repairs. I can use practical help more than anything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with sorting donations and basic repairs — just tell me when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate that. I’m still getting the details, so I’m glad you’ll help get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll let folks on the block know as soon as I can. Just send me the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet—where’s the repair drive taking place?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s at the community center parking lot tomorrow morning. I’ll bring a clear list of the drop-off items so it’s easy.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks — I’ll head to the community center parking lot tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — what time is the repair drive starting, and do you still need volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — I’m not sure of the exact start time yet, so I’ll check and let you know. We may still need volunteers, but I want to confirm before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Hana — please let me know the start time when you confirm. If you do need volunteers, I can help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I can ask around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a big help. I’ll keep an eye out too and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’m heading out now, and I’ll ask around while I’m out. If I hear anything, I’ll let you know right away.
